Isabel Archer's desire for freedom takes a dark turn when she inherits a fortune that places her at the mercy of cunning manipulators. In Henry James's 'The Portrait of a Lady,' we dive into the tumultuous journey of a spirited American woman navigating the complex web of European society. As Isabel struggles against societal expectations and her own ambitions, she becomes ensnared in the schemes of those closest to her, including the enigmatic Gilbert Osmond, whose charm hides a chilling agenda.

This audiobook unpacks the central conflict between personal liberty and the constraints of wealth and influence. Listeners will experience Isabel's evolution from an idealistic young woman to someone grappling with the heavy consequences of her choices. Themes of betrayal, identity, and the pursuit of happiness resonate throughout, inviting deep reflection on what it means to truly live for oneself.

Join Isabel as she confronts the complexities of love, loyalty, and the price of freedom. Will her quest for autonomy result in liberation or entrapment? Discover the intricacies of her relationships and the haunting questions that arise as she seeks her own portrait of a life well-lived. Prepare for a captivating exploration of ambition and moral ambiguity that will leave you pondering long after the last chapter.

title: The Good Man's Radio Show
author: LemmyX Goodman
description: Ever since I could remember there was music in my life or rattling around in my head. As I was born in 1966 I was too young to really appreciate the great musical styles of the times, but I was brought up on the 70’s music of 10cc, Bowie, Roxy Music etc. so all was not lost. I have been passionate about early Garage/Psych since my teenage years but I discovered very quickly that the more I was to delve into the past musically the more pathways and other avenues of musical styles opened up to me leading into a fascinating world of Blues, R ’n’ B, Rock, Soul,  Ska, Folk, Pop etc. After many happy years of collecting vast quantities of music from the era 1960 to about 1978, I started to wonder if there was anyone else out there in the big wide world who shared the same passion as I did. This in turn led me to seek out possible venues playing the kind of music I adored. But despite living just outside of Birmingham there was nothing happening locally. I found myself travelling to London to get my ‘fix’. As this was a logistical nightmare I started to look into a possible cheaper radio ‘fix’... surely there must be something happening? Actually I found much to my disappointment, very little or many dead links of now defunct shows. Well I decided I then only had one choice, to put on the sort of radio show that I would love to tune into myself and hopefully so would others. Well here we are with the finished product. The Good Man’s Radio Show. I hope you find yourself awfully glad that you stopped by my little bubble of joy and I am able to spread at least a little of the joy I feel myself when I listen to my music. If I can spread the word of all these (sometimes) forgotten gems and start a whole new generation of people looking to explore the possibility that music doesn’t have to be dull and lazy, which I tend to feel an awful lot is now sadly, then so much the better. Thanks for tuning in folks, enjoy the trip. .LemmyX

If you’re ready to learn to:
Replace your thoughts with what God says about  you
Create your lasting identity in Christ
Build a relationship with God that brings you His peace
Then this Podcast is for you!
Grab your Bible and my hand as we jump down the rabbit trail to find your true identity as a daughter of the King.

title: The Agrarian Librarian
author: Edmund Farms
description:
The Agrarian Librarian is a podcast about reevaluating our priorities, reducing unnecessary dependence, and becoming more connected to the people, places, and systems that sustain our lives.

Through conversations about philosophy, production, community, and politics, the show explores what happens when we redirect our attention away from distant institutions and abstract national debates and toward the people, places, skills, and systems directly around us.

Agrarianism here is not nostalgia or a rejection of technology and modern life. It is about recovering what remains valuable from the past while making thoughtful use of the present. It means understanding where things come from, developing useful skills, strengthening local relationships, producing more of what we need, and becoming less dependent on systems that leave us with little agency.

Episodes range from food, farming, land, and local production to economics, culture, technology, political philosophy, and the institutions that shape our lives. The common thread is a simple question: what can we actually build, improve, and influence from where we stand?

The Agrarian Librarian is about becoming more capable, more connected, and more deliberate about the lives and communities we build.

description:
Meet the legendary detectives whose methods have shaped modern crime-solving. In "Great Detectives and Their Methods," George Dilnot dives into the lives of iconic investigators like Sherlock Holmes and real-life sleuths who cracked the toughest cases of their time. Each chapter unveils a gripping tale where intellect meets intuition, revealing the unique strategies that led to groundbreaking discoveries. From meticulously gathering evidence to understanding the psychology of criminals, listeners will explore the art and science behind these brilliant minds.

As Dilnot chronicles each detective's journey, he uncovers the central conflicts and challenges they faced in their pursuit of justice. What drives a detective to solve a case that seems impossible? How do they navigate the fine line between genius and obsession? Listeners will discover the thrilling tension of the chase, the moral dilemmas involved, and the profound impact these detectives had on their communities.

With vivid storytelling and insightful analysis, this audiobook not only pays homage to the greats but also serves as a masterclass in detective work. Whether you're a true crime aficionado or simply curious about the methods that defined an era, this exploration of great detectives promises to keep you on the edge of your seat. title: The Questions That Won't Leave Us Alone
author: Erika Celeste
description:
A podcast about the questions humans have been asking for thousands of years. 
Some questions  just refuse to stay quiet.
What happens when we die?
Can love be measured?
Does consciousness exist outside the body?
Why do smart people sometimes fall victim to con artists?
Just how far can positive thinking go to change our lives?
And what if the answers to some of our biggest mysteries are stranger—and more fascinating than we ever imagined?
Welcome to The Questions That Won’t Leave Us Alone, a podcast for the curious, the skeptical, the believers, and anyone who has ever looked at the world and thought, Wait… but what if?
Hosted by award-winning journalist and storyteller Erika Celeste, this is where we explore the questions that sit at the edges of what we know and refuse to let them go.
Episodes dive into mysteries surrounding everything from death and the afterlife, to consciousness, unexplained phenomena, extraordinary human experiences, and the nature of existence itself.
But this isn't about telling you what to believe. It’s about asking better questions.
Erika brings her decades of experience as a journalist and storyteller to conversations with fascinating  experiencers, experts, and people whose stories challenge everything we thought we understood.
We’ll examine extraordinary claims without automatically accepting them, question conventional explanations without automatically rejecting them, and follow the evidence down rabbit holes wherever they may lead.
Because some of the most interesting questions don't have easy answers.
Come curious. Stay skeptical. Keep an open mind.
Because the biggest mysteries aren't always the ones with answers.
Sometimes, they're The Questions That Won't Leave Us Alone.

In 'The Journey to the Center of the Earth,' Jules Verne masterfully blends adventure with groundbreaking ideas about geology and evolution, inviting listeners to contemplate the mysteries of our planet. As the group descends into the depths, they face not only external threats but also their internal conflicts: courage versus cowardice, curiosity versus despair. Each twist and turn unveils a new wonder, igniting Axel's passion for science despite his fears.

As Griffin navigates the challenges of a world that cannot see him, he grapples with isolation, desperation, and the moral dilemmas of unchecked ambition.

Listeners will be drawn into Griffin’s harrowing journey as he struggles with the duality of his existence—free yet trapped, powerful yet vulnerable. The tension escalates when his attempts to reconnect with society lead to chaos and violence, leaving a trail of fear in his wake. What happens when the human mind pushes the boundaries of science? How does one reconcile the thirst for knowledge with the price of madness?

Through Wells’ masterful storytelling, The Invisible Man explores themes of identity, ethics in scientific exploration, and the often thin line between genius and insanity. Each twist and turn of Griffin's story raises questions about the nature of humanity and the consequences of our choices. description:
The moment Gabriel Conroy delivers his poignant speech at the annual dinner sparks a revelation that reverberates through the heart of Dublin. In *Dubliners*, James Joyce intricately weaves together 15 captivating short stories that explore the lives of ordinary people navigating the complexities of early 20th-century Irish society. Each tale acts as a window into moments of self-discovery, love, and the elusive quest for identity amidst the backdrop of a rapidly changing Ireland.

From the bittersweet longing of a young boy in ‘The Sisters’ to the haunting epiphanies in ‘The Dead’, Joyce captures the essence of human experience—the hopes, dreams, and disillusionments that define us. As characters grapple with their desires and societal expectations, listeners will find themselves reflecting on their own crossroads of life. The stories illuminate the struggles of the middle class, revealing how history, culture, and personal choices intertwine to shape their destinies.

Joyce’s masterful storytelling invites listeners to experience the richness of Dublin life, provoking thought and emotion with every twist and turn. With its vivid characters and sharp insights, *Dubliners* remains a timeless exploration of what it means to be human in a world filled with both promise and disappointment. Join the journey and discover the profound moments that await in this celebrated collection.

title: Talks with the Soul
author: Richmond
description:
Talks with the Soul is a podcast for the part of you that knows. 

This isn't for the part of you that performs, explains, and desperately holds everything together. Its for what's waiting underneath all of that. For the one that was here before you learned who to be. 

Every episode opens the same way, with a single line and a breath: this is a sacred space...not a safe space. What follows is not a lecture and not a lesson. It is one voice speaking to one listener, tracing the questions we are usually too busy to ask. Who am I? Why am I afraid? How did I get here? What remains when the noise finally stops? 

Along the way, the voices that spoke the same truth across the ages keep us company. Christian mystics, Zen teachers, Sufi poets, the sages of the Upanishads and more. They are not here as authorities. They are here as witnesses, confirming something you already carry. 

This is not a path toward becoming someone new. It is simply a way back home, to the one you have always been. 

Come as you are. There is nothing here to fix.

This series explores meditation through the lens of personality, helping you discover practices that complement the way you naturally think, process, focus, and experience the world.

Explore pet health and wellness through both modern veterinary medicine and traditional holistic practices, with conversations designed to help us better understand, love, and care for our animals throughout their lives.

Expect honest comparisons between cruise lines and experiences, practical advice about cabins, itineraries, excursions, pre- and post-cruise stays, and plenty of conversation about what cruising actually feels like once you’re onboard. Because Viking vs. AmaWaterways, Azamara vs. Oceania, Antarctica vs. the Galápagos, or a 500-passenger ship vs. one carrying 5,000 isn’t really about which one is “better.” It’s about which one is better for you. Whether you’re planning your first cruise, ready to leave the mega-ships behind, dreaming about a bucket-list expedition, curious about river or yacht cruising, or simply wondering what your next journey should look like, The Savvy Cruise Edit will help you make sense of the choices. title: Wooden Gifts for Design Lovers
author: Eathi Najaf
description:
In the world of design, thoughtful details and well-crafted objects have the power to transform spaces and enrich everyday life. Wooden gifts hold a special place in this landscape. With their warm textures, organic forms, and timeless appeal, they combine functionality with beauty—making them perfect for design lovers who appreciate pieces that both perform and inspire. From heirloom keepsakes to sculptural décor, handcrafted wooden creations elevate interiors while nurturing emotional connection. In this post, we explore transformative wooden gift ideas that resonate with aesthetic sensibilities and design values.

1. The Enduring Allure of Wood in Design

Wood has been central to human creativeexpression for millennia. Its versatility allows it to adapt across styles—from minimal modern to rustic, mid-century, and contemporary art. Unlike synthetic materials, wood ages gracefully; its patina evolves over time, inviting a sense of continuity and lived experience.
For design lovers, wooden objects are not just gifts—they are pieces that tell a story. Whether used as décor or daily tools, well-crafted wooden pieces harmonize with a space, offering warmth and textural contrast to materials like metal, glass, and stone.


2. Keepsakes That Capture Personal Moments

Custom Engraved Memory Boxes

A keepsake box crafted from solid wood—such as walnut, maple, or oak—can hold treasured mementos like photographs, letters, or jewelry. Personalized engraving adds a deeply emotional layer: names, dates, or meaningful quotes transform a beautiful box into a cherished heirloom.
Design lovers will appreciate not only the sentimental value but also the craftsmanship: dovetail joints, hand-rubbed finishes, and meticulous attention to grain direction make such pieces both functional and artistic.

Engraved Photo Frames with a Twist

Photo frames are a classic gift, but wooden frames with custom laser engraving take them to a new level. Rather than a generic design, subtle carved details—like geometric patterns, botanical elements, or bespoke typography—bring a refined, design-centric quality. Choose sustainably sourced wood for an eco-conscious touch.

3. Functional Art: Everyday Pieces That Elevate Interiors

Handcrafted Wooden PlantersPlants and interiors go hand in hand, and wooden planters make the union even more compelling. A planter crafted from cedar or teak—especially with a sculptural form—becomes an art piece in its own right. For design lovers who favor organic interiors, these planters add fluidity and natural rhythm to living spaces.

Pair them with succulents, ferns, or trailing vines for a dynamic interplay between greenery and grain.
Artisanal Cutting Boards & Serving Trays

Every home chef knows the joy of using a beautifully made cutting board. But for design enthusiasts, cutting boards and serving trays are more than kitchen tools—they are statement pieces.

Boards with mixed-wood inlays or geometric patterns become striking centerpieces on countertops or dining tables. They make everyday rituals—chopping herbs, serving cheese, or presenting breakfast in bed—feel elevated. When not in use, they can even serve as artful wall hangings.

4. Sculptural Decor: When Wood Becomes Art

Abstract Wooden SculpturesFor lovers of modern design, abstract wooden sculptures offer a tangible way to introduce organic form into their space. These pieces can range from sleek and minimal to expressive and tactile. Their tactile surfaces and flowing lines provide a contrast to sharper architectural elements, infusing interiors with warmth and movement.

Whether placed on bookshelves, consoles, or mantelpieces, these sculptures act as focal points—sparking curiosity and conversation.

Wooden Wall Art

Wall art doesn’t have to be canvas or print. Wooden relief panels, carved mandalas, or layered wooden wall installations add depth and dimension to flat surfaces. Because wood carries texture and shadow, these pieces change appearance with light throughout the day, engaging the viewer in a subtle, living dialogue.

Design lovers will appreciate the careful interplay between negative space and form, as well as the harmony with existing materials like plaster, brick, or metal.

5. Functional and Stylish Accessories

Hand-Turned Wooden Bowls and VesselsHand-turned wooden bowls and vessels are deceptively simple—they function as holders for fruit, keys, or decorative objects, yet their curved silhouettes and natural grain make them design focal points. Woods like olive, cherry, and ash add distinct color tones that complement varied palettes.

These pieces reflect the beauty of imperfection: slight variations and asymmetrical forms reveal the maker’s hand, reinforcing the connection between object and artisan.

Designer Wooden Clocks

A clock is both functional and decorative. Wooden clocks with minimalist dials, geometric forms, or contrasting wood accents appeal to design lovers who prize subtle sophistication. Mounted on living room walls or displayed on desks, they keep time while anchoring spaces with balance and rhythm.

Opt for sustainably harvested wood and non-toxic finishes for a gift that aligns with both aesthetic and ethical values.

6. Personalized Decor that Tells a Story

Custom Wooden Nameplates & Signs

Personalized wooden nameplates—whether for home offices, entryways, or bedrooms—combine utility with bespoke design. Laser-cut typography in classic serif or modern sans-serif fonts creates a statement piece that feels both personal and artful.Add layered wood elements, painted accents, or engraved motifs for an added design punch.

Decorative Wooden Candlesticks and Holders

Wooden candlesticks, either minimal or ornate, add warmth and ambiance to interiors. Choose tapered, turned forms for classic elegance or asymmetrical shapes for a more contemporary look. When paired with beeswax or soy candles, these holders encourage calm rituals—dinner gatherings, evening reflections, or quiet mornings.

7. Sustainable Design: A Gift with Environmental Integrity

One of the defining qualities of wooden gifts is their potential for sustainability. When wood is responsibly sourced—from reclaimed timber, salvaged barnwood, or FSC-certified forests—design lovers receive not just a beautiful object but an ethical one.

Sustainable wooden pieces emphasize longevity over disposability: handcrafted objects meant to be used, treasured, and passed down. This commitment to durability echoes design principles that value thoughtful materiality and mindful consumption.

8. Craftsmanship and Customization: The Heart of Transformative Gifts

What elevates wooden gifts above ordinary décor is craftsmanship. True design lovers recognize and value the nuance of skillful making. Each handcrafted wooden piece—whether turned on a lathe, carved with chisels, or assembled through precision joinery—bears the imprint of human intention.

Customization amplifies this impact. Personalized wood gifts signal a deep understanding of the recipient’s tastes, lifestyle, and aesthetic values. The result is not just an object, but a meaningful experience—one that connects giver, maker, and receiver through design.

9. Curating Wooden Gifts for Design LoversWhen choosing a wooden gift for a design enthusiast, consider:
  • Function + Form: Will the piece serve a practical purpose while expressing aesthetic value?

  • Material Quality: Does the wood’s grain, finish, and tactile quality align with refined design sensibilities?

  • Personal Meaning: Does customization or personal resonance add depth?

  • Space Integration: Will it complement existing interiors or become a compelling focal point?

  • Sustainable Values: Is the piece responsibly sourced and built to last?

A thoughtful wooden gift is an investment in beauty, functionality, and emotional resonance—making daily life feel more designed, intentional, and joyful.

title: The Words and Magic of Music in The Rings of Power
author: Phillip
description: Everyone loves Bear McCreary's score to the Rings of Power. I’ll let you into a secret. Bear writes his music in code. Let me help you decode the soundtracks to The Rings of Power in this educational guide. Each character, place or idea in Bear’s scores has a recognisable melody or tune that sets it apart from all other characters and he has a pattern or blueprint that he uses for many of his themes. In interviews, Bear described how he sat down at the beginning and wrote all of the themes before he actually started to score the episodes. Part of this process was talking with the show runners about the trajectory of characters so that he could include at the inception those future ideas as musical developments. Each podcast I will examine one musical theme and discover what the music is telling about the character, the place or the idea. Some of these are mind-blowing. Join me in a journey through Bear’s score so you can better understand what is happening and get greater enjoyment from the show as this window gives you a glimpse into the hidden areas of the stories.

author: Kristen Plake
description:
Are you a high-performing woman working in healthcare, emergency services or another demanding leadership role? Maybe you can handle the crisis, make the difficult decision and be the person everyone relies on, but when the workday ends, you have a much harder time leaving it behind.


Women Under Pressure is a podcast for ambitious women who want to succeed at a high level without sacrificing their mental health, physical health, relationships or the rest of their lives in the process.


Hosted by Kristen Plake, a licensed trauma therapist and founder of Frontline Wellness Group, the show explores what demanding careers ask of women and how to build a life that can sustain both ambition and wellbeing.


Kristen brings more than 15 years of experience in healthcare and mental health to these conversations, along with a personal understanding of frontline life from growing up as the daughter of a police officer. Her clinical work focuses on trauma, burnout and the cumulative effects of careers that require people to repeatedly manage crisis, responsibility and uncertainty.


Through practical solo episodes and honest conversations with experts and women doing demanding work, Women Under Pressure goes beyond traditional conversations about stress management and self-care. You'll learn more about how your experiences affect you, why it can be so difficult to switch off even when the crisis is over, and what can help you recover without asking you to become less driven or walk away from work that matters to you.


You’ll also hear answers to questions such as:

👉 Why can't I switch off after work?

👉 Why am I exhausted even when I'm still performing well?

👉 How do I stop bringing work home with me?

👉 What are the signs of burnout in high-performing women?

👉 How does trauma exposure affect me over time?

👉 How can I regulate my nervous system after a difficult shift or high-pressure day?


Follow Women Under Pressure wherever you listen to podcasts and learn how to keep pursuing the work and ambitions that matter to you without sacrificing yourself in the process.


Learn more about Kristen and Frontline Wellness Group at frontlinewellnessgroup.com.

title: Unstoppable with Paula Swain
author: Paula Swain
description: Unstoppable with Paula Swain is where real women share honest stories about the moments that changed them—and how they found the courage to keep going. Through conversations about loss, reinvention, relationships, healing, purpose, and starting over, Paula explores what it means to move through life’s hardest chapters and discover what is still possible. These are real conversations about real life, filled with connection, wisdom, laughter, and the reminder that your story is still being written.

title: The Bailey Blitz
author: Bailey Wright
description: Welcome to my show! Your home for everything NFL football, with a special focus on the New England Patriots. Each episode dives into the latest news, game breakdowns, roster moves, hot takes, and storylines from around the league. We'll also cover major college football headlines throughout the season and occasionally bring on guests to share their insights, opinions, and football experiences. Whether you're a die-hard Patriots fan or just love the game of football, there's something here for you every week.

title: The Product Engineers Podcast
author: Peppe Silletti
description:
Product Engineers is the podcast about the convergence of product and engineering in the AI era: what's breaking, what's working, and the craft of doing both well.

author: Helen C.
description: Welcome to "The Reflective Corner" a podcast for anyone trying to navigate life. Join host Helen C. every month as we dive into self-growth, relationship hurdles, and building better habits. Whether you are looking for practical advice, deep philosophical chats or just a little guidance through those unexpected moments, this show is your guide to navigating life. Hit follow so you never miss an episode! LET’S LIVE A LITTLE!

title: Mammoth in the Room
author: Woolly Mammoth Theatre Company
description: Former Washington Post Theater Critic Naveen Kumar sits down with the groundbreaking playwrights and artists producing new work at Woolly Mammoth Theatre in Washington DC. Filmed at the Eaton Hotel in downtown DC.

title: View From The Bridge
author: Chief Marketer Network
description: From the Studios of Chief Marketer Network, View from the Bridge delivers candid conversations with the leaders responsible for navigating complex organizations and uncertain markets. Host Dave Colford, Chief Revenue Officer at Access Intelligence, explores how senior executives interpret the landscape ahead, weigh competing pressures, and make decisions that shape the direction of their companies. Thoughtful, strategic, and grounded in real leadership experience and built for the executives steering the ship.

description:
What Makes You Tick? Is a conversation podcast where host Ryan Watson, interviews actors, film-makers and a whole range of other artists based in the North East (and sometimes beyond). We talk about what they do, how they make it work and the media that inspires them to do what they do.
Join us every Wednesday!

author: Faith Offix Media

Welcome to Faith Offix Media, Inspiring Faith. Transforming Lives.

Excellence in editing and sharing messages from/for men of God,
making God’s Word accessible to transform lives.


CONTACT US:

Where Faith Meets Excellence

author: Tyler Dane
description: Gospel-centered productivity. Exploring what the bible says about work and time management so we can be more intentional with our time and faith.

title: Little Christs
author: David Cupples
description:
Little Christs is a thoughtful podcast hosted by David Cupples, a retired minister of the Presbyterian Church in Ireland. Each episode offers a devotional and practical exploration of what it truly means to live out a relationship with our Lord Jesus Christ in everyday life. The podcast goes live on 20th September and over the next 18 months around 400 episodes will be released at a rate of one bundle  of 5 per week. 


Drawing on a lifetime of pastoral experience, David unpacks Scripture, connecting biblical truths to the challenges and opportunities of modern living. Little Christs invites listeners to consider how a living union with Christ  shapes attitudes, actions, and relationships with God and with other people, encouraging a transforming and deeper walk with Christ.


Whether you’re seeking quiet reflection, spiritual encouragement, or practical guidance for daily discipleship, this podcast will aim to provide a steady and meaningful companion on the lifetime journey of becoming more like Him.


Whether you are new to the faith or have walked with Christ for many years, this introduction offers both challenge and encouragement: the call to Christlikeness is for all, and it is worked out in the details of everyday living. 


The episodes of this podcasts dig deep into the scriptures, both the Old Testament & New Testament, looking at Christ as he is presented in the whole story of the Bible.

title: Beyond BS Podcast
author: Beyond BS
description: Beyond BS is a podcast about the real side of gaming and content creation—creator burnout, AI, careers, parenting, mental health, online culture, and the conversations the industry doesn't have often enough.

title: Healing with God's Blueprint w/ Dr. Deb
author: Dr. Deb
description:
What if your symptoms are not the problem—but clues to something deeper?
Join Dr. Deb York as she explores the science of functional medicine, peptide therapy, heart health, healthy aging, metabolism, hormones, inflammation, brain health, and the many ways the body communicates when something is out of balance.
Learn practical ways to better understand your body, ask better questions, and make informed choices about your health. Because getting older does not mean settling for feeling worse. 
Knowledge replaces fear—and the body was designed to heal. God designed it that way!

title: That's Cool! Does It Pay?
author: Rebekah Head
description:
Welcome to That's Cool! Does It Pay?: a podcast all about creatives working across Aotearoa New Zealand and Australia. In each episode, Rebekah Head chats with various creatives to learn what makes up the creative tapestry of their life. We’re here to celebrate their successes and all the little wins in between that make the big moments possible.


Follow TD!DIP? on Instagram: instagram.com/thatscooldoesitpay

Follow Rebekah on Instagram: instagram.com/tinybekah


Music by Bray Jeffery (instagram.com/songswithbray)

title: OutsideLooKINGinPOD
author: Jaiquil Marshall
description: A  journey through life, laughter, pop culture and sports on my podcast. Delve into personal takes on various topics and hear from others as they share their perspectives. Tune in for engaging discussions, diverse viewpoints, and a blend of entertainment and insight.

title: Wired & Hammered
author: Boyne Labs
description: Wired & Hammered cuts through the hype. We talk shop with founders, execs, PMs, estimators, foremen, and operators building real systems in heavy civil, mining, and vertical construction.

title: Pigmented Taboo
author: Pigmented Taboo
description:
Pigmented Taboo is an unapologetic series where three Black gay men and their guests lay it all bare. Discussing identity, intimacy, joy, rage, healing, and everything in between. Broadcasting from London, we cut through the noise to centre the voices, stories, and experiences too often pushed to the margins.


From navigating queer nightlife and dating politics to family, faith, masculinity, and mental health. No topic is off-limits. This isn’t about respectability. It’s about truth. Loud, layered, and lived-in.

title: Castellanos Productions Podcast
author: Castellanos Productions

castellanosproductions.substack.com

title: The Life Without School Podcast
author: Stark Raving Dad
description: The Life Without School Podcast is your grounded, research-backed companion for homeschooling, unschooling, and raising your kids outside the system. Hosted by Issy (aka Stark Raving Dad), a home educating dad of four, each episode offers clear, honest guidance to help you build a life that works - for your child, and for you.

title: The Smiley Perspective
author: Amira Smiley
description: The Smiley Perspective is a podcast of historical topics and conspiracy theories. Each week I discuss a new topic that caught my interest and share my perspective on it. From ancient times to recent history, there is an era for everyone, and nothing is off the table.

title: The Question of Education
author: Ben Lawless and Tom Mahoney
description: The Question of Education is a monthly podcast for people who can't stop asking why. Hosted by Ben Lawless, education's mascot, and Tom Mahoney, a philosopher of education, the podcast asks the questions that sit beneath everyday conversations about schools, teaching and learning. Through conversations with researchers, school leaders and practitioners, we unpack ideas, challenge assumptions and examine different perspectives on the purpose and future of education. One hour. Once a month. For educators and anyone curious about education.

title: Wednesdays @ 3:00 - nmc hsm
author: nmc.hsm
description: Every Wednesday at 3:00 the High School Ministry staff get together in the fieldhouse to talk through the upcoming night and pray -- Over the years we've noticed that the conversations we have during this time provide a lot of insight into our hearts and what the Lord is up to... so we thought we'd record them! This is meant to be a raw look into our hearts, the high school ministry at NMC, and where we sense God is taking us. Enjoy the ride!

title: The Adventures with Frisbee Rob
author: Frisbee Rob
description:
When a question refuses to leave Rob alone, the Wind begins to stir.
Join Frisbee Rob as he travels through time to meet scientists, inventors, explorers, and other Great Minds whose curiosity changed the world. Together, they experiment, make mistakes, laugh, learn, and discover that every answer can lead to another question.
Original stories for curious kids, bedtime, quiet time, and family car rides.
Keep wondering. Keep trying. Let the Wind guide you.

title: ABCRA Down The Road
author: ABCRAdowntheroad
description:
Every rodeo has a story, and Down the Road is where those stories come to life.
Hosted by award-winning country music artist and proud rural Australian Jake Whittaker, this new ABCRA podcast takes listeners behind the scenes with the people who make camp drafting and rodeo what it is today.
Each episode features honest conversations with competitors, officials, industry leaders and personalities who share their experiences, lessons and passion for the lifestyle.
Whether you're heading to your next event, travelling the highways or relaxing at home, Down the Road is your chance to connect with the people and stories that shape the ABCRA community.

title: Inter’views’ with christ
author: interviewswithchrist
description:
Hosted by Layton, Inter’Views’ with Christ explores what it actually looks like to live out your faith—not just talk about it. Through honest conversations with athletes, creatives, leaders, and everyday people, we dive into the real-world tension of surrendering our plans, ambitions, anxieties, and struggles to Jesus.
New episodes drop Friday. Follow to join the conversation.

description: Closer To You is a podcast aimed at exploring creativity, identity, and alignment through honest conversations with artists, DJs, designers, entrepreneurs, and creators from every walk of life. Every story is an opportunity to better understand ourselves, our creative process, and what it means to live authentically. It's about exploring how we feel more in tune with ourselves when we create, and how creation can impact others.

title: The Library of Transformation
author: Charlene Mankou
description: Welcome to The Library of Transformation with Charlene Mankou, Master Professional Coach. A library of real-life tools, data-backed strategies, and honest conversations for personal growth, relationships, and becoming better than yesterday. Each episode is a book on your shelf.

title: Parental Discretion
author: Hosted by Lauren Foster and Georgia Nicholas
description: The is podcast for Christian parents and guardians who want to talk about sex, relationships, and identity with their kids. Every home has a table, a place where stories, values, and faith are passed on. This podcast explores how this everyday space can become a model for discipleship and a foundation for healthy, hope-filled conversations about growing up. Created by Big Kids Table in partnership with Positive Media, the first season invites adults to not only discuss and learn how best to sexually disciple their children, but also reflect on the tables they were raised at their own experiences in this realm. The podcast aims to equip adults to work towards redeeming their own stories, build confidence, and offer age-appropriate, ongoing dialogue about bodies, relationships, and faith. You do not need perfect answers. You need open hearts, curious minds, and a place where the whole truth can be explored.  Pull up a chair and join us as we raise a generation of resilient disciples with healthy sexuality.

title: The Homeschool Closet
author: Tess & Bec
description:
The Homeschool Closet is a podcast for homeschool mums who want homeschooling to feel less overwhelming and more doable. Join Tess and Bec for honest, encouraging conversations about the highs, lows, messes, mistakes and magic of homeschooling. We’ll chat curriculum, books, sibling chaos, finding your rhythm and keeping it simple... without pretending we’ve got it all figured out. Whether you’re just starting out or only thinking about it, pull up a chair and join us in the closet!
Real homeschooling. Real mums. No perfection required.

title: Fit Beyond 40

Fit Beyond 40 is a podcast about the stories behind staying fit, strong and healthy beyond 40.
It features conversations with everyday people about the role fitness plays in their lives - what drives them, how their approach has changed, the challenges they’ve worked through and what they’ve learned along the way.
Through real stories, setbacks, breakthroughs and practical lessons, Fit Beyond 40 explores the many different ways people are finding purpose, confidence and enjoyment through fitness as they get older.

Conversations with the people behind the research.

Latin America fintech, product, and AI from an operator who's been building here for seven years.
Each episode: where capital is moving, which products are working, what the region's biggest fintechs and banks do next, and what it means if you're building or investing here.
No press releases. Deal flow, numbers that hold up, honest takes.

description:
Desert X is a contemporary art exhibition framed by the mountains and desert of the Coachella Valley. On this podcast, we'll introduce you to some of the artists of Desert X 2019. Their site-specific artworks range from murals and projections to large-scale sculptures and virtual installations. And they take on big themes like fossil fuel use, rising sea levels, and class divides. Desert X runs from Feb 9 - April 21, 2019.

title: The Witcher Retrospective Addendum
author: Kyle Scher and Claudia O'Flaherty
description:
This podcast series is a continuation of a written article series. The Witcher Retrospective between Kyle Scher and Claudia O'Flaherty was a collaborative article series documenting their journey through the various forms of the franchise. Kyle is a series veteran and Claudia was a newcomer to the franchise. The main section of that rerospective is now over, but audio addendums will be added over time to cover new parts of the franchise or sections skipped over.

title: Quantum on the Treadmill
author: John Willis
description:
Welcome to Quantum on the Treadmill.

Over the past few months, I’ve been trying to understand quantum physics—and honestly, it hasn’t been easy. I’m not a physicist, and equations aren’t naturally how I think. Instead, I ask strange questions: Why whole numbers? What is Planck’s constant? And why did anyone believe these ideas in the first place?

Most of these questions came to me while walking on the treadmill. So I began using AI to challenge my assumptions, explore the history, and help me make sense of the science.

Then I realized I could automate almost the entire creative process without stepping off the treadmill—from capturing the conversation and organizing the ideas to creating the script, audio, and visuals.

This series is an experiment in learning, exercise, AI, and curiosity.

title: Open Secret
author: Makayla Ronga
description: In this raw debut of Open Secret, host Kay delivers an unfiltered manifesto on radical honesty. Driven by a ”laziness” that makes performing exhausting, Kay challenges you to dismantle societal conditioning, stop hiding behind labels, and confront your inner critic (dubbed ”Venom”). By distinguishing between productive guilt and toxic shame, Kay urges listeners to stop playing the victim, embrace their messy truths, and do the terrifying, liberating work of authentic self-acceptance every day.

title: DJ’s Thoughts

description: Nothing But Ball.

title: Between Us
author: Key To Us
description:
A new podcast from Key To Us.
Money, the chores, the silence after a fight. The conversations couples keep postponing, and what's actually underneath them. No experts, no homework, no side taken. One small thing to try tonight, every time. Between Us is for people who love each other and are still figuring it out. Nobody's in trouble here. Some of them are quieter: thirteen minutes you do rather than listen to, before the conversation.
First three episodes on 8 September, then a new one every Tuesday.
Between Us is made by the people behind Key To Us, the relationship companion for couples.

author: Chris Duncan
description: Conversations on faith, history, culture, science, and life. Wisdom for the long journey.

title: REM FM: The Sleep Station
author: REM FM: The Sleep Station
description:
Think of us as your nightly stop between wakefulness and rest, the quiet place where the day loosens its grip and sleep takes over.
Here, you'll find many worlds to wind down within. Drift through the quiet vastness of space, sink into the still, velvet dark of the deep sea, wander through gentle fantasy tales, or settle into cozy bedtime stories crafted for all ages.
Whether you need to quiet a racing mind, escape into something peaceful, or just want a familiar voice to fall asleep to, REM FM will be here for you every single night.

title: Éire i mo chroí
author: Taylor Nivienne
description:
Benvenuti a Éire i mo chroí, un podcast che celebra l'Irlanda con racconti e poesie in italiano, inglese e irlandese. Unisciti a me in questo viaggio tra tradizioni, magia e leggende irlandesi. 
Welcome to Éire i mo chroí, celebrating Irish culture, stories, and poems in three languages: Italian, English, and Irish. Each episode takes you through the rich heritage of Ireland. 
Fáilte go Éire i mo chroí, podchraoladh ag ceiliúradh traidisiúin, draíocht agus finscéalta na hÉireann. Tógfaidh tú le linn már scéalta agus mo dhánta. Beidh gach eipeasóid ar fáil i mBéarla, Iodáilis agus Gaelige.

title: DV Needs Public Service
author: PSA CPSU NSW
description: Domestic and family violence is a public safety crisis. Yet the essential services designed to protect victim-survivors have been outsourced to a patchwork of NGOs, competitive tenders, and insecure contracts. This fragmented model has left people falling through the cracks, services stretched beyond capacity, and no clear accountability when things go wrong.

title: $72.80 Project
author: Noah Daube-Valois
description:
Massachusetts seniors need our help.


In the second costliest state in the U.S., nursing and rest homes residents are forced to survive on $72.80 a month. That’s often not enough to afford toiletries, clothing, and over-the-counter medications — never-mind birthday gifts for grandchildren. That’s why seniors receive $200 in Alaska, $163 in Nevada, $160 in Florida, and so forth.


This is the story of our elderly neighbors who live on $72.80 in one of the richest states, in the richest country in the world.

title: Samir Libari Podcast
author: Samir Libari
description: Chico Loco 40, Moroccan-American rapper, songwriter, music producer, actor, journalist, and technology entrepreneurship Samir Libari, professionally known as Chico Loco 40, is building an international creative and technology platform through CL40 World, combining music, media, software development, journalism, and digital entrepreneurship under one global vision

title: The Reformation! (1517-1555)
author: Dirk Hoffmann-Becking
description: When Martin Luther published his 95 theses on October 31, 1517 the world changed fundamentally. Europe split right down the middle and an age of individualistic exploration began. Or did it? Was it really just the actions of a junior lecturer at a second tier university that blew up the world? What were the circumstances and actions that brought about this fundamental change.

title: The Maracot Deep: Underwater Adventures
author: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
description:
When Professor Maracot unveils his groundbreaking diving bell, he opens the door to secrets hidden beneath the Atlantic Ocean. Joined by two adventurous American companions, he embarks on an expedition that spirals into the extraordinary. As they plunge into the depths, they uncover not just the stunning wonders of marine life, but also a world steeped in ancient mystery and unforeseen peril. The thrill of discovery quickly turns into a race against time when they encounter an unexpected force that tests their ingenuity and courage.

Throughout this gripping adventure, themes of exploration, camaraderie, and the clash of science and the supernatural unfold. Each twist and turn brings challenges that push the boundaries of human understanding and reveal the depths of human spirit. With echoes of classic adventure tales, ‘Maracot Deep’ invites listeners into a realm where the ocean’s vastness holds both beauty and danger.

Get ready to experience the thrill of the unknown as Maracot and his team navigate treacherous waters, unravel age-old enigmas, and confront a rival that challenges everything they thought they knew. Will they return to the surface with their discoveries, or will the ocean claim them? Dive into this exhilarating tale and find out!

title: Healing Space with Alero
author: ARUTERE SOPHIA ALERO
description:
Healing Space is an intentional space for inner healing, emotional balance, and personal transformation. Through thoughtful conversations and gentle reflections, this podcast supports you in reconnecting with your inner self and creating a life rooted in awareness, peace, and growth.
Here, healing is not a destination—it is a continuous act of nurturing who you are becoming.

title: The Journey of Integration
author: Lori A. Fox
description: The Journey of Integration Podcast explores the human journey through science, spirit, and connection. Hosted by Lori A. Fox, this podcast bridges psychology, spirituality, metaphysical exploration, relationships, and holistic wellness through meaningful conversations about healing, growth, and self-discovery. Together, we'll explore consciousness and the ongoing process of integrating the many parts of what makes us human!

title: Soft Rebellion —Unwritten
author: Jaskaran Chahal
description:
A spoken extension of The Unwritten Heart.
Soft Rebellion: Unwritten is a space for reflective conversations around love, emotional truth, tenderness, nervous systems, healing, nature, and the complicated beauty of being human.
Hosted by Jaskaran Chahal.

title: You Know What’s Strange?
author: Tyler Maicach
description:
You Know What’s Strange? dives into the real stories that sit just outside the ordinary.
True crime. Unexplained mysteries. Paranormal encounters. Cryptids. Cults. Bizarre history. Strange science. Disasters. And real events that sound almost impossible.
Each episode takes one story and digs into what happened, what we actually know, the evidence, the theories, and the details that still don’t quite make sense.
Some stories are disturbing. Some are unbelievable. Some are just fascinating.
But every one of them leaves you asking the same thing:
You know what’s strange?

title: Ozark Mountain Bigfoot
author: The UneXplained Network
description: Deep in the heart of the Ozarks and beyond, strange things stir in the shadows.Ozark Mountain Bigfoot dives deep into Missouri’s most chilling Bigfoot encounters, local legends, and unexplained wilderness mysteries. Each episode features eyewitness stories, expert interviews, and a closer look at the folklore that makes the Show-Me State one of America’s most overlooked cryptid hotspots.Whether you’re a believer, a skeptic, or simply someone who loves a good backwoods mystery, join us as we explore the stories, encounters, and evidence behind Missouri’s wildest tales.There’s a reason they call it the Show-Me State.Ozark Mountain Bigfoot — Exploring the unknown, one story at a time.
